lines.text: Hallelujah!
How good it is to sing praises to our God,
how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
The LORD builds up Jerusalem;
He gathers the exiles of Israel.
He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their wounds.
He determines the number of the stars;
He calls them each by name.
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;
His understanding has no limit.
The LORD sustains the humble,
but casts the wicked to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving;
make music on the harp to our God,
who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass to grow on the hills.
He provides food for the animals,
and for the young ravens when they call.
He does not delight in the strength of the horse;
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him,
who hope in His loving devotion.
Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem;
praise your God, O Zion!
For He strengthens the bars of your gates
and blesses the children within you.
He makes peace at your borders;
He fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends forth His command to the earth;
His word runs swiftly.
He spreads the snow like wool;
He scatters the frost like ashes;
He casts forth His hail like pebbles.
Who can withstand His icy blast?
He sends forth His word and melts them;
He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
He declares His word to Jacob,
His statutes and judgments to Israel.
He has done this for no other nation;
they do not know His judgments.
Hallelujah!

pictures.scene: Domenichino, Saint Cecilia Playing the Viol — the saint drawing the bow across the strings with her eyes lifted, Hallelujah, how good it is to sing praises to our God
pictures.name: pd_domenichino_lofzang

pictures.scene: Jean Fouquet, The Building of the Temple of Jerusalem — the masons and carpenters raising the walls stone by stone, how pleasant to praise Him, the LORD builds up Jerusalem
pictures.name: pd_fouquet_bouwt

pictures.scene: Bernardo Strozzi, The Healing of Tobit — the son's hands on the blind father's face giving him back his sight, He gathers the exiles of Israel, He heals the brokenhearted
pictures.name: pd_strozzi_gebroken

pictures.scene: Jacopo Bassano, The Good Samaritan — the traveller lifting the beaten man up out of the road with his own hands, and binds up their wounds, He determines the number of the stars
pictures.name: pd_bassano_wonden

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, Starry Night — the whole sky burning with stars over the dark trees, He calls them each by name, great is our Lord and mighty in power
pictures.name: pd_millet_sterren

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, The Milkmaid — the servant pouring in quiet daylight with all her attention on the work, His understanding has no limit, the LORD sustains the humble
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_nederige

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Suicide of Saul — the fallen king lying on the rocks as the battle sweeps past him, but casts the wicked to the ground
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_goddelozen

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — David with both hands in the strings singing by candlelight, sing to the LORD with thanksgiving, make music on the harp to our God
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_harp

pictures.scene: John Constable, Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows — the rain-cloud rolling off the spire with the rainbow standing behind it, who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth
pictures.name: pd_constable_regen

pictures.scene: Savoldo, Elijah Fed by the Raven — the bird bringing bread down to the prophet in the wilderness, He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call
pictures.name: pd_savoldo_raven

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, Conversion on the Way to Damascus — the horse standing over the man thrown flat on his back in the road, He does not delight in the strength of the horse
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_paard

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the crowds kneeling in from every side toward the Lamb on the altar, the LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion
pictures.name: pd_eyck_lam

pictures.scene: Gaudenzio Ferrari, Concert of Angels — the whole dome full of angels singing and playing on every instrument, exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem, praise your God, O Zion
pictures.name: pd_ferrari_sion

pictures.scene: Jacob Jordaens, Suffer the Little Children to Come Unto Me — the mothers bringing their children up to Christ and His hand laid on them, He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you
pictures.name: pd_jordaens_kinderen

pictures.scene: Ivan Shishkin, Rye — the ripe wheat standing shoulder-high along the quiet cart path, He makes peace at your borders, He fills you with the finest wheat
pictures.name: pd_shishkin_tarwe

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Annunciation — Gabriel rushing in headlong with the dove blazing in the light before him, He sends forth His command to the earth, His word runs swiftly
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_bevel

pictures.scene: Hendrick Avercamp, Ice Landscape — the snow lying on the roofs and the townsfolk out on the frozen water, He spreads the snow like wool, He scatters the frost like ashes
pictures.name: pd_avercamp_sneeuw

pictures.scene: Willem van de Velde the Younger, A Ship on the High Seas Caught by a Squall — the vessel laid right over in the breaking sea under a black sky, He casts forth His hail like pebbles, who can withstand His icy blast
pictures.name: pd_velde_hagel

pictures.scene: Alexei Savrasov, The Rooks Have Returned — the snow melting into standing water and the rooks back in the birches beside the church, He sends forth His word and melts them, and the waters flow
pictures.name: pd_savrasov_dooi

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Prophet Ezekiel — the prophet turning with the scroll in his hand and the other hand thrown open, He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_woord

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua Passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — the priests carrying the ark down into the river bed under the pillar of light, He has done this for no other nation
pictures.name: pd_west_volk

pictures.scene: John Singleton Copley, The Ascension — Christ rising into the open sky with His arms thrown wide and the disciples below with their hands lifted, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_copley_halleluja
